Reconstruct his portrait as the same brown sepia ink drawing, not a new color portrait, actor or anime character.
Preserve the reference notice design: heading exactly "ANKÜNDIGUNG!" in dark bold serif capitals at the top; a large thin rectangular portrait box beneath; seven or eight dark wavy faux-writing lines below the box; small plain ochre wax seal at lower right; thin double dark border on warm honey-brown parchment. Preserve this specific man and the general heading, add no names, dates or invented readable text.
One entire upright portrait paper, perfectly front-on, no original skew/perspective; paper aspect about 0.66, centered in a square 1:1 image with 10% clear margin, all four edges intact and fully inside canvas.
